handback.title: Test commands, branches and the bot follow settings
handback.summary: Workflows take their test commands, test folder, branches and bot from the repo's settings, not Dokima's own.
handback.user_story: Workflows run the repo's test commands and use its branches and bot, as its settings name.

test_changes.tests/test_keys.py::test_a_build_starts_: The default branch now comes from settings; still checks the worker merges it first.
test_changes.tests/test_checks.py::test_full_suite_ru: The command moved to the shipped settings; checks it there: every test, `-n auto`.
test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_a_replan_check: The default branch now comes from settings; still checks against its split, not the head.
test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_the_rivers_sig: The bot's name now comes from settings; still only a bot skips the gate.
test_changes.tests/test_merge_check.py::test_the_merg: The test command now comes from settings; the step is also found by its tests.

raises.label: Doubt: overlaps #744
raises.text: #744 also asks for the test exclude list. Build it here and leave #744 the rest? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: #744's body: `tests.exclude` keeps tests the repo marks off the merge gate, default empty.

raises.label: Two exclude lists
raises.text: The plan adds a new list of tests, by path, apart from the gate's list of checks. Is that right?
raises.evidence: `dokima/defaults.yaml` `gate.exclude: [card, board wait]` names checks, not tests.

raises.label: Pushed commits' name
raises.text: Pushed commits already use the app's own name. Keep that, and move only the fixed names? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: `agent.yml` push step sets `user.name` from the app token's `app-slug`; merges hardcode `dokima-runtime[bot]`.

answers.why: A new test runs a planner with no branch and checks it starts from trunk.
The 795.10 test now runs the planner's merge of main too, checking its author.
The 795.8 test now checks the record's conversation link names the history branch.
